views.long:
List the money that waits in Undeposited funds and that a deposit can take: every posted line on an Undeposited funds account that no posted deposit holds.

`line` of a row is the value for `{"line": "<line>"}` of an item of `deposits add` (it is also the `id` of the row). A row shows what the person who pays is named by: the customer or the vendor, the payment method and the reference number (a check number). The rows are in the order of the deposit form: by date, then by number.

  tinycld books deposits undeposited --customer <customer id>
  tinycld books deposits undeposited --search 4411 --json
